Warmest regards

Sue

host_about:
I'm originally from Spain but I've been in JP for almost 26 years when work and study brought me to Boston.  I love traveling and exploring different cultures.  I also love being outdoors especially riding my bike around town or walking my very friendly small dog, Henri.  He is hypoallergenic and he does not shed.  He lives on the second floor but if you met him you'd want him to visit you.  Henri is adorable and lovable!  He is like a teddy bear.

I have hosted for short and  long periods many medical researchers, medical visitors, visiting professors, high tech, artists, English learners etc from all over the world.  
House is between Green line (MSPCA stop) and Orange Line (Stony Brook).  Ten min walk to Whole Foods.  My  house is 2 miles to Harvard School of Medicine, Longwood Medical area, Northeastern and a bit further but not far the medical campus of Boston University, 10 min T ride from Back Bay where you can find The Arquitectural School and MFA is 2.3 miles away.

description: Welcome to Boston! Perfect for families, groups, or business travelers, our space combines comfort and convenience in a vibrant neighborhood. Enjoy off-street parking, easy access to public transit, local dining, and popular attractions like Franklin Park Zoo and the JFK Library.
host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile.

I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

name: Family & Group Haven near Downtown Retreat
description:
Bring your family, friends, and pet to this two-story Bohemian style treasure, a hidden gem in the Boston/Dorchester Area.

Enjoy ample parking space for 2 cars, the privacy of a great night of sleep with blackout shades and gel-memory foam mattresses, and pillows.

Dearly called #TheBackDorch
host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

We explicitly welcome people from every corner of the world, and everyone who believes in respect and love for all others.

description:
This large (200 sqft) bedroom is located in a house close to Roslindale Village. With its many restaurants and cafes, this place has the perfect combination of an international small-town village.
The commuter rail is less than 0.3 M away from the house, Forrest Hill T Station a little over 1 mile. There are no less than 10 busses going there directly from the village.

host_about:
I live in Boston and like to do short trips to cities in many countries. I work as a consultant all over the world.
I believe that wasting time is a good thing, we are overscheduled, overinvolved, and overstretched. Traveling allows me to kick back and go to museum just because. Or sit in café, if I am too tired for a museum, or do both.
My favorite city is Barcelona, although Boston great, too, and so is Buxtehude, my home town in Germany. I believe you can find beautiful things in almost all cities, and in the end it is more about whom you travel with and whom you meet. 
My girlfriend and I just started hosting, but already had guests from many parts of the world.

Many wise people have said many wise things. There is a German saying "If you say A, you also have to say B", which is to say that you have to follow through if you have started something. Einstein responded to that: "If you say A, you don't need to say B, you can also see that A was wrong". How about that for humbleness of an atheist. Well, I wasn't there when he said it, but this is what lore has ..
Between my girlfriend and me, we can help you with German, English, French , Chinese, some Spanish and some Japanese. 
We explicitly welcome people from every corner of the world, and everyone who believes in respect and love for all others.

host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

name: Nightingale's Boston Retreat
description:
Boston brownstones don't come in a standard mold. This one sits on Quincy Street in Roxbury, a third-floor unit in a historic building with high ceilings, natural light, and a layout that feels generous for two bedrooms.

In-unit washer and dryer, a fully equipped kitchen, dedicated off-street parking, and pets welcome. Six guests, one bathroom, zero compromises on the things that matter.
host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

description:

The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

host_about:
We have been providing vacation rental apartments for over 10 years across the East Coast. We are known for our distinctively furnished apartments in popular locations, and for our attentive service. You’ll find that our rates are quite reasonable. If you're looking for a safe, comfortable place with fabulous amenities and Wi-Fi (we know you need the Wi-Fi!) in the Boston MA area, Washington DC, Miami FL or very close to NYC in Jersey City or Hoboken, we'd love to host you. Many of the buildings where our apartments are located feature amenities such as beautiful lobbies, 24 hour front desk staff, fitness centers, business centers, recreation rooms, indoor or outdoor pools and whirlpools. If you are traveling with children, some buildings offer playgrounds (many buildings are near public playgrounds as well) or indoor playrooms. Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more. 

We offer an assortment of short-term apartments in sizes ranging from a studio to three bedrooms that are fully furnished with all the comforts of home. Our local staff meticulously prepares your apartment before your arrival, and we offer 24 hour assistance for any emergencies after business hours. When you arrive at your apartment, the beds will be made, towels and bath amenities will be stocked in the bathrooms, and the coffee maker will be set up in the kitchen with some sample coffees, sweetener and creamer (teabags too if that is your preference) to start your morning off properly. If you’d like to cook a meal, the kitchen is stocked with dishes, cutlery, glassware and pots and pans. The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

name: In-Unit Laundry | Your Family & Friends Space
description:

Meet all your home needs with the convenience of on-street free parking, an in-unit washer and dryer, fully stocked kitchen, dishwasher, and ample space to dine in or sleep in. host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

Sue

Our local staff meticulously prepares your apartment before your arrival, and we offer 24 hour assistance for any emergencies after business hours. When you arrive at your apartment, the beds will be made, towels and bath amenities will be stocked in the bathrooms, and the coffee maker will be set up in the kitchen with some sample coffees, sweetener and creamer (teabags too if that is your preference) to start your morning off properly. If you’d like to cook a meal, the kitchen is stocked with dishes, cutlery, glassware and pots and pans. The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

name: Elegant FIDI 1BR in the Theater District
description:
What’s more exciting than the latest sell-out show in the Theater District? This gorgeous condo, of course! Within just a couple blocks of Boston Common, Chinatown, and the top arts venues in town, this modern apartment is the perfect home base for any trip to Boston. Highlights include:
- Luxurious decor, high ceilings, and large windows
- Modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances
- Hotel-style lobby and 24-hour concierge
- Historic architecture with a fully renovated interior
host_about:
We have been providing vacation rental apartments for over 10 years across the East Coast. We are known for our distinctively furnished apartments in popular locations, and for our attentive service. You’ll find that our rates are quite reasonable. If you're looking for a safe, comfortable place with fabulous amenities and Wi-Fi (we know you need the Wi-Fi!) in the Boston MA area, Washington DC, Miami FL or very close to NYC in Jersey City or Hoboken, we'd love to host you. Many of the buildings where our apartments are located feature amenities such as beautiful lobbies, 24 hour front desk staff, fitness centers, business centers, recreation rooms, indoor or outdoor pools and whirlpools. If you are traveling with children, some buildings offer playgrounds (many buildings are near public playgrounds as well) or indoor playrooms. Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more. 

We offer an assortment of short-term apartments in sizes ranging from a studio to three bedrooms that are fully furnished with all the comforts of home. Our local staff meticulously prepares your apartment before your arrival, and we offer 24 hour assistance for any emergencies after business hours. When you arrive at your apartment, the beds will be made, towels and bath amenities will be stocked in the bathrooms, and the coffee maker will be set up in the kitchen with some sample coffees, sweetener and creamer (teabags too if that is your preference) to start your morning off properly. If you’d like to cook a meal, the kitchen is stocked with dishes, cutlery, glassware and pots and pans. The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

description:

host_about:
We have been providing vacation rental apartments for over 10 years across the East Coast. We are known for our distinctively furnished apartments in popular locations, and for our attentive service. You’ll find that our rates are quite reasonable. If you're looking for a safe, comfortable place with fabulous amenities and Wi-Fi (we know you need the Wi-Fi!) in the Boston MA area, Washington DC, Miami FL or very close to NYC in Jersey City or Hoboken, we'd love to host you. Many of the buildings where our apartments are located feature amenities such as beautiful lobbies, 24 hour front desk staff, fitness centers, business centers, recreation rooms, indoor or outdoor pools and whirlpools. If you are traveling with children, some buildings offer playgrounds (many buildings are near public playgrounds as well) or indoor playrooms. Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more. 

We offer an assortment of short-term apartments in sizes ranging from a studio to three bedrooms that are fully furnished with all the comforts of home. Our local staff meticulously prepares your apartment before your arrival, and we offer 24 hour assistance for any emergencies after business hours. When you arrive at your apartment, the beds will be made, towels and bath amenities will be stocked in the bathrooms, and the coffee maker will be set up in the kitchen with some sample coffees, sweetener and creamer (teabags too if that is your preference) to start your morning off properly. If you’d like to cook a meal, the kitchen is stocked with dishes, cutlery, glassware and pots and pans. The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

host_about:
Like you I enjoy traveling, and especially like to find a comfortable and clean place to rest.  I hope you find that place in the studio apartment in my home.  As a Peace Corps Volunteer I lived in Yalta, Ukraine, shortly after the breakup of the Soviet Union.  That afforded me the opportunity to travel throughout Eastern Europe and Russia.  Since then I have worked in the Balkans, and have also traveled throughout Africa.  Currently I am focused on the trafficking of women and other aspects of modern day slavery, and am looking forward to new horizons.

One of the great things that I enjoy in Boston is it’s open space.  My home is located within several blocks of three of those great parks.  Another great treasure in the Boston area--and one of the reasons that I moved to Boston--is it’s location on the ocean, and the opportunity to sail.  You can go on whale watches, cruises around the harbor, or take the water taxi to visit Old Ironsides.  Boston also has wonderful museums and a great public transportation system to take you there.

host_about:
Hi there, 

Thanks for looking up my listing, I hope you like what you see. 

I currently host in Providence, RI. My home is in a diverse and historic neighborhood. 
The home was built in 1910, it is large, welcoming and clean. 
It  has 3 stories, 6 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms & multiple common areas. Plenty of room to socialize if you wish so, or to keep to oneself if preferred. 
Whatever you do, please be kind, clean and considerate. 

I typically spend my week days in Boston and my weekends in Providence. When not in Boston or Providence, I can be found on photo assignments around New England or playing with pups! When not playing with pups, on assignments or hosting, I may be found roaming the the world. My favorite part of the world is South East Asia (I've spent multiple Winters in Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Japan, China, Myanmar, India, The Philippines and Indonesia to name a few ;)). More recent trips have taken me to Guadeloupe, Panama, Colombia and various other Central and South American countries. I grew up in Europe and speak French, Spanish and English and understand, or have notions of, a few other languages. I love discovering new cultures & meeting new people. 

I started hosting in 2016 and I’m loving it and  the chance to meet & host people from all corners of the world and walk of life! 

Your comfort & happiness under my roof (and out of the home) during your visit are very important to me; I always thrive to please my guests and, hopefully, surpass their expectations whenever I can! :) 

I adore pets and occasionally swing by with a furry friend or two. I allow up to two pet guests at a time. Please do not book with me if you have allergies or do not enjoy sharing your home with pets. I may or may not have furry friends during your visit. 

It is important to me that my guests are clean, kind, mature, considerate, respectful and friendly. No party, no loud anything and no smoking at the home please. Music/musicians and fun conversations are always welcome on the other end (but not expected). 

I look forward to hearing from you and hopefully hosting you soon; don't hesitate to reach out or ask anything. :)
